Bologna Shoah Memorial

Monument · Bologna, Italy

This monument was unveiled on 27th January 2016, on International Holocaust Remembrance Day. It stands alongside the railway line, just steps from the new high speed rail station. Two tall volumes in Corten steel, opening slightly towards the road, converge up to form a gap of just 80 cm wide, creating a strong sense of oppression and disorientation. And indeed the passing of time, day after day, will work upon the appearance of this work in Corten, a type of steel which naturally oxidises in the open air.
